definitions: To spend time relaxing or socialising, especially in a casual way.
To reside or be found in a particular place.
To lean or protrude from something.
To display something, especially clothes, by hanging it on a line or rail.
examples: We often hang out at the local pub on Fridays.
Where do the cool kids hang out these days?
His tongue was hanging out as he ran.
She went to hang out the washing in the garden.
